name: gilded-griffin
description: The Gilded Griffin — management portal for a cozy fantasy bookstore

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @griffin/catalog -w @griffin/patrons -w @griffin/incidents -w @griffin/gateway -w @griffin/portal
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n catalog,patrons,incidents,gateway,portal -c yellow,green,red,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @griffin/catalog" "npm run dev -w @griffin/patrons" "npm run dev -w @griffin/incidents" "npm run dev -w @griffin/gateway" "npm run dev -w @griffin/portal"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
